title: iOS 1.18 — First-run setup and a smarter Check Briefing
body:
- New first-run setup: choose your default profile, add your aircraft (including whether it's FIKI equipped) and your usual kind of flying in a few quick steps. You can skip it, and it only appears once per account.
- Check Briefing with Siri and Shortcuts: on the day of your flight it now starts with any live alerts and the latest highlight, then gives the briefing's grade. It also shows a card with Refresh and Open Briefing buttons.
- Observations: when an airport has no METAR or TAF of its own, a line now names the nearby airport used in its place.
